modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Build a four-row matrix keyed by physical CX7 adapter/controller, with traffic state, telemetry source, all five timestamped fields and chip-limit result.

modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Port numbering may describe connectivity rather than controller index; the authoritative board/telemetry map controls identity.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, procedure and criteria consistently target four CX7 chip sensors across five views. Generic clear and DeepSeek's incomplete/overbroad collection are method defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Topology, exact member set, access and SPEC are identifiable inputs. Execution becomes BLOCKED only if controller identities cannot be distinguished from other chip/transceiver resources after obtaining them.

review_improvement: Extends the family-specific component mapping into a complete five-view contract and explicitly rejects generic chip overmatch.
independent_technical_reasoning: CX7 controller junction and transceiver module temperatures represent different hardware and limits, while generic sensor filtering can return other board chips. Four explicit controller identities bound to adapter topology are therefore necessary before cross-interface correlation can demonstrate coverage.
